consultation_price_per_minute_paise.description: Global consultation price in paise per minute. 900 = Rs.9/min.

min_wallet_to_start_paise.description: Minimum spendable balance (paise) required to start a consultation. Default = 2 minutes.

warn_level1_sec.description: Remaining seconds at which the Level 1 low-balance popup appears.

warn_level2_sec.description: Remaining seconds at which the Level 2 critical bottom-sheet appears.

reconnect_timeout_sec.description: Seconds a client may be disconnected before the session auto-pauses.

session_timeout_sec.description: Seconds a paused/disconnected session survives before auto-end.

request_timeout_sec.description: Seconds an astrologer has to accept an incoming request before it is missed.

commission_percent.description: Platform commission percentage deducted from astrologer gross earnings.

version.description: ASKTRO base Remote Config template — mirrors config/global. Admin edits propagate without an app update.
